inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Compare exact saved cases and optionally remeasure one global point without changing current input, display or measurement history.

references.description: Distinct caseId values are required at runtime. Each reference selects its own stored field and mesh-local selectors.

caseId.description: Opaque page-lifetime identity returned by the matching list/begin operation.

point.description: Optional common global point in mm; no coordinate transform or extrapolation is inferred.

limitations: At most 8 distinct exact case references and 65536 UTF-8 bytes in the JSON value; nested physical arrays are not returned.
Read-only and permitted while calculations run. A changed saved-case lease, invalid selector or revoked command is refused; current input/display need not match the saved input.
Raw stress is Pa and equivalent plastic strain is a dimensionless ratio; viewer MPa/% labels do not rescale these measurements.

Modal results require explicit modeIndex, represent normalized 1 mm shapes rather than dynamic responses, and never produce modal deltas. Transient acoustic results require explicit stored frameIndex; thermal frameIndex selects stored temperature only, omitting it preserves final temperature/heatFlux. Indexed thermal heatFlux is refused; no time interpolation.
bodyIndex and elementIndex require point and refer only to that saved mesh. Outside points or ambiguous bodies may be unavailable; corrupt data and invalid selectors are refused.

Different kinds, fields, units, harmonic frequencies or stored physical times are not silently compared. A compatible numeric difference does not establish equivalent physical assumptions or accuracy.
